  <div class="mission-statement-content">
    <div class="content-wrapper">
      <div class="ms-headline">Conservation action through birds</div>
      <div class="ms-text"> <p>Birds are telling us—in their behavior, in their dwindling numbers, in their silence—that we must take action now, and that we must take action where birds need us most, from the Arctic to Chile and everywhere in between.</p><p> </p><p style="color:#feab01;">It’s time to rise to the occasion.</p> </div>
    </div>
    <div class="button-wrapper">
      <a href="/get-involved" class="button">How You Can Help</a>

    </div>
    <div class="items-wrapper">
      <a href="/our-work/science" class="ms-link"><div class="prop-icon"><i class="fa-nas fa-solid fa-bolt"></i>
</div>
<div class="prop-title">We follow the science</div>
<div class="prop-text">Our science shows where birds go and what they need when they get there. We're prepared to heed that call.</div>
</a>
<a href="/advocacy" class="ms-link"><div class="prop-icon"><i class="fa-nas fa-regular fa-globe"></i>
</div>
<div class="prop-title">We pair advocacy and diplomacy to influence decision makers</div>
<div class="prop-text">Audubon pairs diplomacy with advocacy to achieve conservation outcomes.</div>
</a>
<a href="/get-involved" class="ms-link"><div class="prop-icon"><i class="fa-nas fa-regular fa-location-dot"></i>
</div>
<div class="prop-title">We inspire an expansive Audubon flock</div>
<div class="prop-text">Our chapters and centers are hubs that connect individuals and communities to Audubon and to action. </div>
</a>
<a href="/bird-guide" class="ms-link"><div class="prop-icon"><i class="fa-nas fa-kit fa-a-flock"></i>
</div>
<div class="prop-title">And, of course, we have birds</div>
<div class="prop-text">Birds delight and connect people across cultural, generational, and geographic boundaries. They inspire us to be better. And for 120 years, birds have been the heart and soul of Audubon. </div>
</a>
